issue.title: Make --workspace_status_command work with "Builds without the Bytes".

repository.name: bazel
repository.description: a fast, scalable, multi-language and extensible build system

issue.body:
Fixes #8385

Due to a typo in delete() stable-status.txt would not get deleted
between builds. More details in #8385.

Thanks @emfree for the debugging work and pointing out the root cause!
